title: ACCOUNT_MERGE fails with ACCOUNT_MERGE_SEQNUM_TOO_FAR
pattern: A transaction whose ACCOUNT_MERGE operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (seqnum_too_far). Operation 0 bumps the sequence number past this ledger's starting sequence (ledger << 32); merging could let the account be recreated with a lower number, so core refuses (MergeOpFrame.cpp, isSeqnumTooFar). Operation 0 reports success in the failed transaction.

hazards.placement: merge after a bump past the ledger's starting sequence

facts.says: Operation 0 reports success in the failed transaction.
No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
